declared_before: building the AnnData or running any decoupler MCP tool on GSE198542 (only the GEO sample sheet, the count-matrix header and the PubMed abstract had been read)
design: two separate contrasts, each ~condition, ZIKV vs MOCK (3 vs 3, unpaired): WT = IFNAR2-positive iPSC-macrophages (2 healthy-control lines), MUT = IFNAR2-deficient patient iPSC-macrophages. The full chain (filter, PCA, DE, scoring) is run on each genotype subset separately.

sources.NDE exemplar table (2026-10-28): Interferon/STAT activity in control cells, absent or much weaker in IFNAR2-deficient cells (built-in negative control)
sources.Hanrath et al. 2022 Front Immunol, doi:1: ZIKV infection of macrophages triggers an IFN-I response; IFNAR2-deficient iPS-macrophages show a profound defect of IFN-I signalling, with enhanced ZIKV replication and cell death
sources.IFN-I signalling biology (independent of: STAT1, STAT2 and IRF9 form ISGF3 downstream of IFNAR; MX1 and OAS1 are classical ISGF3-dependent genes. Virus-sensing (IRF3) can still induce some ISGs and IFNB1 without IFNAR, so only ISGF3 readouts are expected to collapse.

expectations.claim: WT: Hallmark INTERFERON_ALPHA_RESPONSE has score > 0 and padj < 0.05
WT: CollecTRI STAT1, STAT2 and IRF9 each have score > 0 and padj < 0.05
WT: MX1 and OAS1 each have log2FoldChange > 0 and padj < 0.05

Negative control, much weaker in MUT: (a) MUT Hallmark INTERFERON_ALPHA_RESPONSE score < 0.5 x WT score; (b) mean of MUT CollecTRI scores for STAT1, STAT2, IRF9 < 0.5 x the WT mean; (c) MX1 and OAS1 MUT log2FoldChange < 0.5 x WT log2FoldChange (a gene removed by filtering in MUT counts as log2FoldChange 0)
expectations.source: Hanrath 2022 (profound IFN-I signalling defect) + NDE exemplar table

expectations.claim: Report only: genes kept and PCA per genotype, including whether extraction date tracks a top PC; DE gene counts; top 10 TFs, PROGENy and Hallmark sets per genotype; IFNB1 and IRF3-target behaviour in MUT; NF-kB and cell-death signals in MUT
